## Before merge

- [ ] Full staged diff reviewed; no unrelated files or credentials included.
- [ ] Relevant local checks passed; limits and documentation are updated.
- [ ] `verify` CI passed for the current PR revision/base; missing/skipped checks are not accepted.
- [ ] Required owner merge approval received; commands/policy are not treated as cosmetic prose.
- [ ] No task-branch or uncommitted configuration has been deployed; deployment requires its own approved scope and merged revision.
